title: elionurus muticus var. gracilescens
intro: Elionurus muticus var. gracilescens, commonly known as Chinese Silver Grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is used in traditional Chinese medicine and is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Chinese Silver Grass include reducing inflammation, improving immune function, and protecting against oxidative stress. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
